item.title: College Recruiting: state placewinner Phrakonkham to Minnesota State University Moorhead
item.description: Ian Phrakonkham of Fosston/Bagley has committed to wrestling for Minnesota State University Moorhead next season. Phrakonkham is a three-time state qualifier for The Brawlers, placing fourth at 133 pounds in Class A in 2025 as a junior. Phrakonkham is projected to wrestle at 133 or 141 pounds for the Dragons.
